name: avro-a-type-the-document-does-not-define-is-refused
why: ADR-023. An Avro fullname carries no version, so resolving it would bind to whatever that subject holds at read time - the silent behaviour change ADR-017's gated latest pointer exists to prevent, one layer down in the reference graph. Refusing is protocol, not a .NET choice: an SDK that resolves this would accept schemas the registry will not.
